meta.note: Company facts are public-record knowledge as at the tracker date; each entry should be re-verified before external use. Company-site locations are well-known public facts (plants, ports, operations).

findings.finding: No South African company is publicly known to be building a full autonomous-driving stack (perception-to-control) for public roads.
South Africa has a deep, globally-scaled telematics/fleet-software industry (e.g. Mix Telematics, Ctrack) — a natural base for fleet intelligence and safety analytics.
South Africa has global-scale heavy commercial vehicle manufacturing (Ford Ranger, VW Polo, Toyota Hilux lines) but no domestic autonomy-component supply chain yet.
Mining autonomy suppliers (Caterpillar, Komatsu, Epiroc, Sandvik, ASI) have active SA channels via mining houses; SA is a leading market for PGM/coal/iron automation readiness.
